mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and 76 degrees at the Verona Public Library. Also, look up tonight for the ISS, which will be visible starting at 9:05 PM for two minutes, rising over Mount Horeb and heading toward the Fitchburg and Madison area about halfway up the sky.

The Verona Police Department released information regarding the arrest of 34-year-old Halla Nelson of Madison. On August 30, the school district reported an inappropriate relationship involving a staff member and a student that occurred in 2019. An investigation resulted in an arrest this past Friday on one count of sexual assault of a child by a school staff member.

Today you can head to Insight Wellness for yoga. Tomorrow is packed with fun including trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, Paddy Mac's, The Mill, and The Bogey Factory, plus the Farmer's Market and music at Paddy Mac's.
The police department reported that on Friday, they booked a Madison woman into the Dane County Jail regarding a 2019 sexual assault of a child by a school staff member case.
Today is the perfect day to grab a scoop of the Georgia Peach flavor of the day. The restaurant is currently open and serving until 10 PM tonight.
